title: 第14章 她仍是她第15章 极品销售
content_zh:
“你...你是怎么知道的？”
祝星洲一脸震惊的看着白月，一双眼睛似是要将白月盯出一个洞来。
白月也不好解释自己透视的能力，总不能说自己有一双比x光还要厉害的双眼，一眼就能把他父亲的身体结构都瞧得清清楚楚吧？
这以后要是让人知道了，怕是觉得在她面前都像被扒光了一般，毫无秘密可言。
想到这，白月略一思索，就开始信口胡诌。
“唔...其实我从小就在乡里跟一位老中医学过一些医术，所以略懂些皮毛罢咯。”
祝星洲听罢，露出一脸不可置信的表情。
“那...那刚才你是只凭着望闻问切中的望诊就把我爸的症状给看出来了？”
“算是吧。”
白月挠了挠头道。
尽管这个借口真的很难让人相信，但看来事实就是如此。
祝星洲父子也只好相信了她的说辞，但心中却也还是震惊非常。
看她的样子满打满算也才五六岁吧？竟然懂得这么多！她还是不是人呀？
就算她是打娘胎里就开始学习，五六年也学不了多少东西呀！
就在祝星洲父子还处于震惊之时，白月又抛出了一个平地惊雷。
“你这问题不算是多严重的病，我有办法能给你治好，也能帮你保守秘密，但我是有要求的。”
“你...你真的能治？”
祝星洲似是在黑暗中看到了丝许光亮，激动的问道。
“嗯哼~就是希望你们能把这件事情的来龙去脉告知与我，并且到我的手底下来工作，我就答应给你治好这病。”
“当然，我并不会要你做什么违法犯罪的事情，都是明面上的正经工作，也能为你带来财富，让你们父子过上正常的生活。”

说罢，白月看了看祝星洲父子犹豫的神情，顿了顿，道。
“我也可以给你一点时间去考虑，你觉得如何？”
祝星洲父子听到白月的要求后面面相觑，竟没想到她会提出这样的要求。
看这女孩明知这只是仿造的古玩，却还是出手五十万买下，家底肯定是非常丰厚的，她的话倒是可以相信几分。
想到这，祝言更是低下了头来，思考了许久。
而后似是下定的什么决心一般，看着白月明亮的眼睛露出了一丝坚定。
“好！只要你能把我这毛病治好，除了违法犯罪的勾当，无论叫我做什么都可以！”
虽然不知道白月到底想要他做什么工作，但只要不拖累儿子，他什么都可以做。
祝言看着自己瘦削不堪的身体，再看了看白月二人，微微叹了口气，随后便开始将这件事情的始末娓娓道来。
“其实，这件事还要从五年前说起...”
“那时，我本在国外的一家大学教美术。”
“有一天我的学生问我，能不能教他做出像华国古玩那样的瓷器？”
“当时我本就喜爱古玩，经他一提醒，我倒是找到了一个新的研究课题，去思索着如何自己原创出像古玩一般，充满着人类智慧结晶的艺术品。”
“艺术的创造大多都是从模仿开始，我便开始仿造古玩，并乐在其中。”
“直到那一天...有一个地下组织的人找到了我，威胁我给他们造假，被我拒绝了，但我转念又想，我在国外势单力薄，恐被报复，就赶紧买了机票回国。”
“最让我没想到的是，这个地下组织的势力盘根错节，在国内国外都有分布，他们不知用什么渠道找到了我的住处，连夜到我家来把我带走，也就有你们看到我在家被带走的那一幕。”
content_en:
"You...how did you know?"
Zhu Xingzhou looked at Bai Yue with a shocked look on his face, his eyes seemed to be boring Bai Yue into a hole.
It's hard for Bai Yue to explain his clairvoyance ability. He can't say that he has a pair of eyes that are more powerful than X-rays. He can clearly see his father's body structure at a glance, right?
If anyone found out about this in the future, she would probably feel like she had been stripped naked in front of her, with no secret at all.
Thinking of this, Bai Yue thought about it for a moment and then started talking nonsense.
"Well...Actually, I have practiced some medical skills with an old Chinese medicine practitioner in my hometown since I was a child, so I know a little bit about it."
After Zhu Xingzhou heard this, he showed an expression of disbelief.
"Then...then just now you were able to identify my dad's symptoms just by looking, smelling, asking, and making precise diagnoses?"
"So be it."
Bai Yue scratched his head and said.
Although this excuse is really hard to believe, it appears to be the case.
Zhu Xingzhou and his son had no choice but to believe her words, but they were still very shocked.
Judging from her appearance, she is only five or six years old, right? He actually knows so much! Is she still a human?
Even if she started studying right from the womb, she wouldn't have learned much in five or six years!
Just when Zhu Xingzhou and his son were still in shock, Bai Yue threw another flat thunder.
"Your problem is not a serious illness. I have a way to cure you, and I can also help you keep your secret, but I have requirements."
"You...can you really cure it?"
Zhu Xingzhou asked excitedly as if he saw a glimmer of light in the darkness.
"Hmm~ I just hope that you can tell me the ins and outs of this matter and come to work under me, and I will promise to cure this disease for you."
"Of course, I won't ask you to do anything illegal or criminal. It's all serious work on the surface, and it can also bring you wealth and allow you and your son to live a normal life."
After saying that, Bai Yue looked at the hesitant expressions of Zhu Xingzhou and his son, paused, and said.
"I can also give you some time to think about it, what do you think?"
Zhu Xingzhou and his son looked at each other in shock after hearing Bai Yue's request. They did not expect that she would make such a request.
Seeing that this girl knew it was just a counterfeit antique, but still bought it for 500,000 yuan, her family must be very rich, so you can believe her words.
Thinking of this, Zhu Yan lowered his head and thought for a long time.
Then, as if he had made up his mind, Bai Yue's bright eyes showed a hint of determination.
"Okay! As long as you can cure me of this problem, you can do anything you ask me to do except illegal and criminal activities!"
Although he didn't know what job Bai Yue wanted him to do, he could do anything as long as it didn't drag his son down.
Zhu Yan looked at his thin body, then at Bai Yue and the two of them, sighed slightly, and then began to tell the whole story.
"Actually, this matter started five years ago..."
"At that time, I was teaching art at a university abroad."
"One day my student asked me if I could teach him to make porcelain like Chinese antiques?"
"I already loved antiques at that time. After he reminded me, I found a new research topic and thought about how to create original works of art that are like antiques and full of the crystallization of human wisdom."
"Most art creation begins with imitation, so I started imitating antiques and enjoyed it."
"Until that day... someone from an underground organization found me and threatened me to fake it for them, but I refused. But then I thought again that I was weak abroad and feared retaliation, so I quickly bought a plane ticket to return home."
"What I didn't expect the most was that the underground organization's power was so intricate that it was spread both at home and abroad. I don't know what channel they used to find my residence., came to my house overnight and took me away, which is how you saw me being taken away at home. "
